title: NoP2Wynn
description: A Wynncraft resource pack that removes pixel jiggling textures on the p2wynn store.
body:
A very simple Wynncraft resource pack that removes the flashy animations from the Wynncraft shop


# Parts included
- Categories on the store front
- Animated layer icons (e.g. star or sale arrow)
- The selected item mini expand
- Arrow wiggle at checkout
